## Problem and change

What user-visible problem does this solve? What behavior changes, and what stays the same?

## Verification

Record the tests and example commands actually run. Separate fixture results from live-model measurements.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
- [ ] Any changed onboarding commands and expected output agree with the tests.
- [ ] Existing source formats, CLI interfaces, and documentation paths are preserved or migration is explained.
- [ ] Implemented behavior is distinguished from planned work.
- [ ] I inspected the diff and every commit for real exports, private paths, credentials, and provider logs.
